description:
Everything about one node type: its help page (purpose, typical uses, inputs and outputs,
        settings, tips and pitfalls, nodes it works well with), its pins, its settings with their
        defaults, and its ui settings. "settings_reference" says what every saved setting means
        (e.g. which number is which direction or operation). Read the help before using a node.
name: describe_node_type
title: Describe a node type
